The '''''Vagrant''''' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[YV-666 light freighter/Legends|YV-666 light freighter]] owned by the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Bandin Dobah]]. It served as Dobah's hideout but was badly maintained and its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] did not work anymore.
